description: Optional, standalone, separately downloadable astronomical observation test dataset for development, algorithm validation, and engineering verification in the SPECTRA-X Observatory platform. This package is strictly optional and independent of application runtime.

REAL_INTRA_VISIT.description: Genuine intra-visit dither observations from SPHEREx Level-2 pointings (P0001, P0002, P0003, P0008, P0009, P0010).

SYNTHETIC_ENGINEERING_TEST.description: Deterministic synthetic observations with simulated multi-day baselines, RA wraparound, and known motion truth.

all_pairs.scientific_disclaimer: REAL SPHEREx Level-2 flight observations. Time baseline dt < 1.0 day is strictly an intra-visit dither; INELIGIBLE as evidence of secular astronomical motion.
